newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields lower in sleepy trade at noon.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields lower in sleepy trade at noon.

text.p: Swedish debt yields were lower on Thursday, in line with most foreign markets, while the crown was slightly weaker against the generally stronger dollar.
Long debt yields were mainly following the German market, traders said.
"Although sentiment is good for the moment, I think investors will start looking for a small correction soon," one analyst said.
The ten year bond yields fell one basis point to 6.55 percent, while the six month T-bill rates were flat at 4.11 percent.

The crown was stable against the mark at 4.4360 compared to 4.4320 late Wednesday. The dollar made small gains against the crown to 7.7653 from 7.7606. Trading in the crown is very quiet, partly due to players taking summer vacations, dealers said.
The market is now focusing on the June labour market statistics from the United States later today.
